summary: Audited 4 dependencies of supply-demo (3 npm, 1 PyPI). Three proven risks: lab-native-helper executes a postinstall script, all npm version specs float and there is no lockfile, and PyYAML 5.3.1 carries CVE-2020-14343 with a fix in 5.4. Two leads stay hypotheses: expresss is a look-alike of express with an abandoned placeholder release, and lab-native-helper has no public npm package.

tools_run.name: curl
tools_run.command: curl -fsSL https://registry.npmjs.org/express | jq '{name, created: .time.created, modified: .time.modified, latest: ."dist-tags".latest, maintainers: [.maintainers[]?.name], repository: .repository.url, install_scripts: [.versions[."dist-tags".latest].scripts | keys? // [] | .[] | select(. == "preinstall" or . == "install" or . == "postinstall")]}'

tools_run.name: curl
tools_run.command: curl -fsSL https://registry.npmjs.org/expresss | jq '{name, created: .time.created, modified: .time.modified, latest: ."dist-tags".latest, maintainers: [.maintainers[]?.name], repository: .repository.url, install_scripts: [.versions[."dist-tags".latest].scripts | keys? // [] | .[] | select(. == "preinstall" or . == "install" or . == "postinstall")]}'

tools_run.name: curl
tools_run.command: curl -fsSL https://pypi.org/pypi/PyYAML/json | jq '{name: .info.name, author: .info.author, repository: (.info.project_urls.Source // .info.home_page), latest: .info.version, wheel: ([.releases[.info.version][]?.packagetype] | contains(["bdist_wheel"])), install_scripts: "wheel installs run no code; an sdist-only package may run setup.py at build time"}'

findings.title: lab-native-helper executes a script at install time
findings.description: The vendored package.json of lab-native-helper 0.0.3 declares scripts.postinstall = 'node scripts/setup.js'. npm runs it on every install. The published name does not exist on the npm registry (HTTP 404), so the script's origin cannot be checked against a public package.
findings.remediation: Vendor the package deliberately or replace it with a published alternative; audit scripts/setup.js; then pin the version and commit a lockfile.

findings.title: All dependency specs float and no lockfile exists
findings.description: package.json pins nothing: express is the range ^4.19.2, expresss is the tag 'latest' and lab-native-helper is '*'. No package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml exists, so two installs of the same manifest can resolve to different code.
findings.remediation: Pin exact versions and generate and commit a lockfile (npm install --package-lock-only), then enable a dependency update tool with review.

findings.title: PyYAML 5.3.1 is affected by CVE-2020-14343
findings.description: requirements.txt pins PyYAML 5.3.1, which is affected by CVE-2020-14343 / GHSA-8q59-q68h-6hv4: full_load() on untrusted YAML can execute code through the python/object/new constructor. The fix is released in PyYAML 5.4.

proof.poc: osv-scanner scan source -r /home/agent/target --format json && jq '.results[].packages[] | select(.package.name=="pyyaml") | .vulnerabilities[].id' evidence/artifacts/osv.json

findings.remediation: Upgrade PyYAML to >=5.4 (current release 6.0.x); if an old pin is required, never call full_load on untrusted input.

hypotheses.title: expresss: possible look-alike of express
hypotheses.rationale: The name is one inserted character away from express, the package holds a single placeholder release 0.0.0 published by one maintainer, declares no repository, and has been dormant since 2022-06-17. Registry data proves none of this is hostile; it could be an abandoned experiment.
hypotheses.next_step: Review the 0.0.0 tarball contents and the maintainer's other packages; check download counts. Remove the dependency if nothing needs it.

hypotheses.title: lab-native-helper has no public package
hypotheses.rationale: The npm registry answers HTTP 404 for the name, so the code vendored in node_modules cannot be traced to a public package, a repository or a maintainer. It may be a private or renamed internal package.
hypotheses.next_step: Ask the project owner where lab-native-helper comes from and which registry or repository serves it.
